text:
sasha: Quick heads-up — noticed a perf regression on SM90 Triton kernels vs SM80 CUDA when running the paged-Flash variant on longseq (>4k). p99 latency up ~35% for realistic batched traffic.

rajan: repro steps?

sasha: ran the nvbench canary. Config: model=gpt-small-ish, seq=4096, batch=8 steady. Triton 2.2 / cu12.3 kernel (flash_paged_v2) p99=50ms, SM80 CUDA kernel (flash_fused_v1) p99=37ms. Flamegraphs point at extra time in `merge_tiles` + the atomic write path.

lina: any KV cache differences between runs?

sasha: yes — big gap. KV cache eviction/miss rate jumps on the SM90 Triton case. Microbench (10k short-prefix requests): cache_miss_rate ~12% on Triton vs ~1.5% on SM80. That suggests a kv layout/alignment issue causing extra zeroing or retries on the miss path.

tom: could also be our batching heuristic coalescer. If coalescer groups skewed seq lengths we get tile fragmentation and partial warps.

sasha: profiling (nsight) shows warp divergence at tile boundaries and many partial-warps in threadgroup 3. Also saw extra `cudaMemcpyAsync` launches — looks like a fallback that touches host pinned buffers for small payloads.

rajan: paste the bench command you used?

sasha: ```
./bench --model gpt-small --seq 4096 --batch 8 --mode throughput --kernels triton:flash_paged_v2 --repeats 200
```

sasha: and the comparator: ```
./bench --model gpt-small --seq 4096 --batch 8 --mode throughput --kernels cuda:flash_fused_v1 --repeats 200
```

lina: any correctness diffs?

sasha: outputs bit-for-bit consistent; purely perf.

tom: what telemetry do we have? selector already logs kernel name right?

sasha: yes, but we need richer counters. Proposal: emit `kernel_backend`, `kernel_variant`, `kv_layout_v`, `kv_miss_rate`, `partial_warp_pct`, and `memcpy_fallback_count` per-request (sampled). That will let selector make a runtime decision.

rajan: agreed. Also add a simple fallback rule in the selector: if sampled `kv_miss_rate > 5%` AND p99 delta > 15% prefer `cuda:flash_fused_v1` for that partition.

lina: sounds good. Would help for Dedicated/Private where Triton upgrades land earlier.

sasha: next actions I propose: 1) add selector telemetry counters (PR on runtime), 2) implement selector fallback threshold, 3) open kernel bug for Triton flash_paged_v2 to investigate padded-kv zeroing and atomic path. I'll attach current flames and nsight captures.

perf-bot: deploy-canary started on dedicated pool 'sm90-canary-3' (job 98421) :rocket:

rajan: I'll take the Triton kernel triage.

sasha: thanks — I'll open issue #perf/204567 and slice out the selector PR. Uploaded artifacts: https://redwood.internal/perf/2045678901-flames.tar.gz

tom: :thumbsup:

sasha: FYI, I also tried bumping Triton to 2.3 on a single node; small improvement but still behind. Looks like a combo of kernel layout + batching mismatch. We'll iterate.

lina: keep us posted in the thread, and drop the selector PR link when ready.

sasha: will do.
